audience: shop and cafe owners who sell with a Zettle point of sale

useCases.title: Review yesterday's sales and refunds
useCases.text: List the purchases of a day with the amounts, payments and refunds. Open one purchase to read the line items and the VAT.

useCases.title: Find products that run low on stock
useCases.text: List the stock locations. Read the stock balance of each product variant and compare it with the low-stock level.

useCases.title: Check the balance and the next payout
useCases.text: Read the account balance and the payout information. List the latest transactions to see the fees and the payouts.

useCases.title: Review the product library, categories and discounts
useCases.text: List the products with the variants, SKU and price. Read the categories and the discounts of the library to find gaps.

useCases.title: Add a new product to the library
useCases.text: Create a product with a name, a price and a VAT rate. The tool does not check for duplicates. Run it once for each product.
